_note: THE FACTION AND PEN-NAME TEST ON THE RUNAWAY PLANT, d OF b TO d. The same job, beats and numbers as MB55a; the site is pinned to one faction (Spacers, the scavengers) and the plant's voice is written from one pen name. Letter variants, so if one works it is a real replay copy.

PEN NAME: home-office office/pennames/momo-hazuki.json. Her heat checks do not apply; her voice does. Plant Control in Momo's register: delighted, direct, exclamations, one list that gets away from it. It tells everyone everything. Nothing melancholy, and it never ends quieter than it started.
Words name the occupiers by role, never by faction name (his ruling: thugs, mercenaries, never the proper name). Journals are the player's record, first person, per Frances on MB55a (2026-10-29).

prose.name: Repairs: Runaway Plant on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The <Place> has been running since its crew fled and scavengers have been stripping it, and its owners say it won't last much longer.
prose.card: Scavengers are picking over the <Place> since our crew fled, and the plant is still running. It won't last much longer. Shut it down.

beats.journal: The plant told everyone about the shutdown, scavengers included, and they're coming for the terminal. I need to hold it until it finishes.
beats.name: Plant Control Terminal
say: Shutdown authorised! That's the coolant, the cores, the pumps, the fans, the other fans, the spare fans, all of it, in several minutes! I've told the scavengers, and they are very upset about it!

beats.objective: Defend the terminal during the shutdown
beats.journal: I held the terminal until the shutdown finished. The <Place> is cold.
say: Shutdown complete! Every system is cold, and I've announced it everywhere, twice!

broadcast: Hello, visitor! This facility has run outside safe limits for forty-four days, a record, and you can shut it all down from the control terminal! The scavengers here haven't asked about the shutdown, so I haven't mentioned it.
_speech: Plant Control, written as Momo Hazuki. The voice id is MB55a's until his ear casts one per variant. Voiced lines: no names, places, factions or currency; the occupiers by role only.
